platformRules: Validate the complete workflow before review, then retrieve and verify the saved workflow after any future create or update operation.
Use n8n credential references and placeholders; never place secret values in workflow parameters, expressions, headers or documentation.
Add an explicit error path for every fallible production node and return appropriate caller errors for webhook workflows.
Use stateless subworkflows for reusable units and pass all required context as inputs.
Do not invent node parameters, node versions, credentials, connectors or expressions that are absent from reviewed evidence.
Require human review before activation or any external deployment; this package never publishes a workflow.
